process.title: Research process
process.subtitle: Independent research → consolidated synthesis → independent audits → post-audit adjudication → prototype validation → final selection.

explorer.tier1Subtitle: Click any card to expand the two reading depths (Quick Understanding / Technical Deep Dive). Original passages, IDs, and source anchors remain unchanged.
explorer.noResults: No candidates match the current filter.
explorer.tier2Body: The leading five candidates have a richer side-by-side layout in finalaudit.md section N. The Technical Deep Dive in any card is built from the same fields; for a full three-way comparison, open the Compare view.
explorer.tier3Body: Three concepts are chosen for actual technical validation. Each card with the prototype badge resolves a distinct uncertainty. HYBRID-008: tier composition; IDEA-073: autonomy-first fallback; HYBRID-002R: a working path if the delegation family fails. See Security & validation for experiments X1–X6.
explorer.tier4Body: The complete 16-field record of every idea and hybrid lives in the Full Research Library.

security.title: Security & validation
security.subtitle: Source: finalaudit.md sections K (security), O (top three validation), R (experiments), and the master inventory. No experiment is reported as completed; every status reads 'Pending — no experiment run'.
security.lossBody: The post-audit package promotes the loss-certificate mechanism (IDEA-026) into HYBRID-008's control plane, alongside the two seed sources R003 C19 and R014 L05371. The formula is shown here as it is used in the package; it is a presentation, not a re-derivation.
security.tiersSubtitle: Owner-signed onchain tiers, with the LLM agent holding only T0 (one-use obligations) plus gas. Routes M and Z are shown.
security.diagramsSubtitle: Diagrams are interpretations of the source architecture. Copy any block into mermaid.live for a rendered image; an inline SVG variant lives on each candidate's detail page.
security.matrixSubtitle: How the three prototype-validation candidates answer each control area. Empty cells mean the source does not address that area for that candidate.
security.experimentsSubtitle: Six experiments cover the top three. The cheapest falsifier, X1, runs first and is due 14 October 23:59 Dhaka. None has been run; no result below is reported as achieved.

history.title: Decision history
history.subtitle: Three stages: the original synthesis (HYBRID-001 preferred), Audit A (adversarial), Audit B (merger integrity), and the post-audit package (HYBRID-008 preferred). Every stage is preserved; the post-audit package is the current snapshot.

overview.leadingTenBody: HYBRID-008 leads under all four weightings (78 balanced). Its lead over IDEA-073 under feasibility weights is 0.7. HYBRID-001, the synthesis's former preference, falls to seventh and is FAIL this round.
overview.threeReasonsBody: Three concepts are chosen for actual technical validation. Each one resolves a distinct uncertainty that the post-audit package flagged.
overview.rankingSensitivityBody: The order changes only under specific weight shifts. HYBRID-008 leads under all four weightings.
overview.nextStepsBody: X1 must pass on at least one route by 14 October 23:59 Dhaka. Stage 1 upload by 16 October. X2 by 17 October, or Stage 2 is cut. Submission deadline 20 October 23:59 Beijing.
